on Friday it regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2).
Nasdaq notified the company on March 2 that its ordinary shares had failed to maintain a minimum closing bid price of $1 for 30 consecutive business days.
The company said its shares closed at or above $1 for 11 consecutive business days from Sept. 9 through Sept. 23.
Nasdaq has determined that Alpha Compute regained compliance, and the matter is now closed.

title: Alpha Compute regains compliance with Nasdaq
